turns.question: What was our net revenue from customers in Germany on 1 October 2026, after returns?
turns.answer: Net revenue from German customers after partner returns was 367.25 EUR for 1 October 2026 (a single day). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
